# Load the libraries and data
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)

# This is the data with the annotated and predicted values (with annotation, visible lipid sac, no visible lipid sac). So make sure to curate first and that an object_id is only considered once. This file also contains a table of the annotated data, and the original list of UVP6 metadata with morphological descriptors (including the images excluded because outside the size range).
load("data/uvp6_lipids_20250407.RData")

theme_set(theme_bw())
`%notin%` <- Negate(`%in%`)
```

# Curate the lipid segmentation data
```{r}
uvp6 <- uvp6_all %>% 
  # remove the predictions for images with manually annotated data
  filter(type != "predicted") %>% 
  # include the metadata for 
  bind_rows(uvp6_meta %>% 
              filter(object_id %notin% uvp6_all$object_id)) %>% 
  mutate(date = as.Date(date)) %>% 
  mutate(Year = year(date),
         Month = month(date),
         DOY = yday(date))

# Make sure that an image is not considered twice. This has to match number of rows 
length(unique(uvp6$object_id)) == nrow(uvp6)

AA <- uvp6_all %>% 
  filter(type == "not visible")
```


# Exploring vertical profiles
## Overall number of images in 100 m depth bins
```{r}
# For all "valid" uvp6 Calanus images with segmentations

binsize <-  100
uvp6_allBin <- uvp6 %>%
  
  filter(type != "predicted")  %>% 
  mutate(depthBin = floor(depth/binsize)*binsize) %>% 
  mutate(depthRange = paste0(depthBin,"m - ",depthBin+binsize,"m")) %>% 
  mutate(depthBin = as.factor(depthBin)) %>% 
  select(depthRange, depthBin, prosome, lipid, lipidfullness, Major) %>% 
  group_by(depthRange, depthBin) %>%  
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), list(mean = mean, 
                                           sd = sd, 
                                           n = ~sum(!is.na(.)))),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  arrange(depthBin)
# Set range to factors
uvp6_allBin <- uvp6_allBin %>% 
  mutate(depthRange = factor(depthRange,
                                levels = unique(uvp6_allBin$depthRange)))

# add cummulative number and percent of images
uvp6_allBin <- uvp6_allBin %>% 
  mutate(percent = lipid_n / sum(lipid_n) * 100) %>% 
  mutate(cumtotal = cumsum(lipid_n),
         cumpercent = cumsum(percent)) %>% 
  mutate(cumpercentRev = 100 - cumpercent)


cowplot::plot_grid(
  ggplot(uvp6_allBin, aes(y = depthRange, 
                          x = lipid_n)) +
    geom_point() +
    xlab("N images") + ylab("Depth bin") +
    scale_y_discrete(limits = rev),
  
  ggplot(uvp6_allBin, aes(y = depthRange, 
                          x = cumpercent)) +
    geom_point() +
    xlab("% images") + ylab("Depth bin") +
    scale_y_discrete(limits = rev),
  labels = "auto"
)
```

## Temporal sampling distribution
```{r}
ggplot(uvp6, aes(x = DOY, fill = as.factor(Year), color = as.factor(Month))) +
  geom_histogram()


binsize <-  100
uvp6_allBin <- uvp6 %>%
  
  filter(type != "predicted")  %>% 
  mutate(depthBin = floor(depth/binsize)*binsize) %>% 
  mutate(depthRange = paste0(depthBin,"m - ",depthBin+binsize,"m")) %>% 
  mutate(depthBin = as.factor(depthBin)) %>% 
  select(Month, depthRange, depthBin, prosome, lipid, lipidfullness, Major) %>% 
  group_by(Month, depthRange, depthBin) %>%  
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), list(mean = mean, 
                                           sd = sd, 
                                           n = ~sum(!is.na(.)))),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  arrange(depthBin)
# Set range to factors
uvp6_allBin <- uvp6_allBin %>% 
  mutate(depthRange = factor(depthRange,
                                levels = unique(uvp6_allBin$depthRange)))

# add cummulative number and percent of images
uvp6_allBin <- uvp6_allBin %>% 
  mutate(percent = lipid_n / sum(lipid_n) * 100) %>% 
  mutate(cumtotal = cumsum(lipid_n),
         cumpercent = cumsum(percent)) %>% 
  mutate(cumpercentRev = 100 - cumpercent)


cowplot::plot_grid(
  ggplot(uvp6_allBin, aes(y = depthRange, 
                          x = lipid_n)) +
    geom_point() +
    xlab("N images") + ylab("Depth bin") +
    scale_y_discrete(limits = rev) +
    facet_wrap(~Month),
  
  ggplot(uvp6_allBin, aes(y = depthRange, 
                          x = cumpercent)) +
    geom_point() +
    xlab("% images") + ylab("Depth bin") +
    scale_y_discrete(limits = rev) +
    facet_wrap(~Month),
  ncol = 1,
  labels = "auto"
)
```

# Individual vertical profiles plot
```{r}
binsize <-  100
uvp6_allBin <- uvp6 %>% 
  mutate(depthBin = floor(depth/binsize)*binsize) %>% 
  mutate(depthBin = as.factor(depthBin)) %>% 
  select(Month, sample_id, depthBin, prosome, lipid, lipidfullness) %>% 
  group_by(Month, sample_id, depthBin) %>%  
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), list(mean = mean, 
                                           sd = sd, 
                                           n = ~sum(!is.na(.)))),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(depthBin2 = as.numeric(depthBin))
  

ggplot(uvp6_allBin, aes(y = prosome_n,
                        x = depthBin2, 
                        color = sample_id)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.2) +
  # geom_point(alpha = 0.2) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = "Depth Bin", y = "Number of images") +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  scale_x_reverse(breaks = unique(uvp6_allBin$depthBin2),
                  labels = levels(uvp6_allBin$depthBin)) +
  facet_wrap(~Month, scales = "free_x")
```

# Old/ Extra -----
## Test vertical profiles
```{r}
# Function to create depth profile average plots
create_plot <- function(var_name, y_label) {
  ggplot(uvp6_allBin, aes(y = depthBin, 
                          x = !!sym(paste0(var_name, "_mean")))) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_errorbarh(
      aes(xmin = !!sym(paste0(var_name, "_mean")) - !!sym(paste0(var_name, "_sd")), 
          xmax = !!sym(paste0(var_name, "_mean")) + !!sym(paste0(var_name, "_sd"))), 
      height = 1) +
    geom_text(aes(label = !!sym(paste0(var_name, "_n"))), hjust = -0.2,
              vjust = -0.5, size = 3) +
    labs(y = "Depth Bin", x = y_label, title = paste("", y_label)) +
    scale_y_discrete(limits = rev)
}
```
